paragraphs.text: Devil Kdanger Nevil (the 'k' is silent) is a devil performer for Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Devil K. Nevil loves being a daredevil and feels most alive as he is soaring through the air, despite having been on fire and broken every bone in his body multiple times. Danger is his middle name, but he can't spell.
